text:
White to move. Two rooks seal every flight square

Black's king on h8 is trapped behind the 7th-rank barrier.

Spot the 1-move finish ♟️

#Chess #SpeedChess #ChessTactics

creative.headline:
LADDER MATE
*SEAL THE 8TH RANK*
creative.footer: Answer with reactions or in replies.

docked_reply.text:
Solution: 1. Ra8# (Ladder Mate).
One rook holds the 7th rank while the second delivers checkmate on the 8th.
